rule: No process-global mutable state in production code: statics with interior mutability, thread-local slots, environment or working-directory reads at the point of use, process-wide hooks and child processes that inherit the live environment. Pass state through the node's configuration and context instead, read the process's arguments and environment once at the composition root, and spawn children with env_clear() plus an explicit environment. check_process_globals.py fails on anything unlisted and on entries that no longer match, so this list only shrinks. 'debt' entries are scheduled for removal (dev-docs/ProcessGlobalsPlan.md in the glade-wz workspace); 'permanent' entries are reads at a program's entry point, items that carry no shared state (such as a temp-name counter), and spawns that clear the environment, env_clear() plus an explicit environment: the checker lists every Command::new whether or not it clears the environment, and gwz-core records its own clean spawn the same way.
source: scripts/checks/check_process_globals.py is gwz-core's checker at commit 730e7119 (gwz-dev workspace), vendored byte for byte; its own tests live there.

entries.name: env::args
entries.reason: Each composition root reads the process's arguments once, at its entry point, and passes them down: run parses them itself, and run_assembled parses them into Settings (Settings::from_args).

entries.name: env::var
entries.reason: GLADE_HOME and HOME, read once as each composition root starts (instance_root_from_env) and passed down as the instance root: into sysdir::boot for the hand-written root, and through Settings for the assembled one. Nothing below the entry point reads them (ProcessGlobalsPlan Step 2.1; a read at a program's entry point is permanent, owner's ruling of 2026-09-26).

entries.name: env::var_os
entries.reason: GLADE_NODE_ASSEMBLED chooses the composition root at the entry point, read once before anything else runs.
